description: French SaaS service purchased by Irish VAT-registered Ltd (EU reverse charge)
notes: Under VATCA 2010 s.12(1) with s.34(a), a service received from a supplier established outside the State, supplied to an Irish business, is self-accounted: the recipient is liable for Irish VAT as if it had made the supply. The 12,300 paid is the net; reverse-charge VAT at 23% is 2,829, recovered as input VAT in the same period. Review required: the rule carries reviewStatus 'ai_extracted' and routes the s.34(a)(ii)-(iii), s.65(2), s.12(2)-(6) cases to named review reasons.
